name: Cohiba Minerals Limited
summary: Cohiba Minerals Limited engages in the exploration of natural resources in Australia. The company explores for metals, precious metals, lithium, gypsum, gold, copper, cobalt, and minerals deposits. It holds interests a 100% interest in the Pyramid Lake project covering a total area of 11,266 hectares located to the north of the Port of Esperance in Western Australia; the Wee MacGregor Project comprising three mining licenses located in southeast of Mt. Isa; and the Olympic Domain Tenements consisting of eight exploration licences covering an area 831 square kilometer located in South Australia. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.
